mapper.select: SELECT goods_id AS goodsId, goods_nm AS goodsNm, status FROM tb_goods_master WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId}

SELECT s.sales_id AS salesId, DATE_FORMAT(s.play_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') AS playDt, s.play_tm AS playTm, s.play_seq AS playSeq, s.status AS status, COALESCE(SUM(a.remain_cnt), 0) AS remainCnt FROM tb_goods_sales s LEFT JOIN tb_goods_seatassign a ON a.sales_id = s.sales_id WHERE s.goods_id = #{goodsId} AND s.status = #{status} GROUP BY s.sales_id, s.play_dt, s.play_tm, s.play_seq, s.status ORDER BY s.play_dt, s.play_tm
